classes.name: EvaluationManifestResolutionLifecycle
classes.description: Deep private Chisei module whose interface owns authorized request replay, invariant and Evidence closure, evaluator validation, fail-closed manifest construction, snapshot consistency, and durable persistence ordering.

classes.name: ChiseiGrpcTransportAdapter
classes.description: gRPC adapter that authenticates Evaluation callers, prepares and projects protocol messages, and delegates deterministic manifest resolution to the resolution lifecycle.

classes.name: ResolvedEvaluationManifest
classes.description: Canonical immutable document freezing the exact plan, evaluator definitions, invariant set, waivers, Evidence, subject binding, and evaluation time used by Evaluation execution.

relations.name: delegates_evaluation_manifest_resolution_to
relations.description: The Chisei gRPC transport delegates the complete deterministic manifest resolution protocol to the private lifecycle module.

relations.name: resolves_canonical_evaluation_manifest
relations.description: The resolution lifecycle produces or replays one canonical immutable resolved Evaluation manifest.
